sparql_tries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?year WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber "26V430000" ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m ; rc:modelYear ?year . ?m rc:name "TELLURIDE" ; rc:ofMake ?mk . ?mk rc:name "KIA" . } ORDER BY ?year
SELECT DISTINCT ?componentName WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber "10V388000" ; rc:affectsComponent ?comp . ?comp rc:name ?componentName . } ORDER BY ?componentName
SELECT ?date WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber "23V651000" ; rc:reportReceivedDate ?date . }
SELECT ?potentiallyAffected WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber "26V430000" ; rc:potentiallyAffected ?potentiallyAffected . }

SELECT DISTINCT ?campNo WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber ?campNo ; rc:doNotDrive true ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:ofMake ?mk . ?mk rc:name ?mn . FILTER(UCASE(STR(?mn)) IN ("HYUNDAI","KIA","GENESIS")) } ORDER BY ?campNo
SELECT ?campNo ?initiatedBy WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber ?campNo ; rc:initiatedBy ?initiatedBy . FILTER(CONTAINS(UCASE(STR(?initiatedBy)), "OVSC")) } ORDER BY ?campNo

SELECT DISTINCT ?campno ?date WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber ?campno ; rc:reportReceivedDate ?date ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:name "PALISADE" ; rc:ofMake ?mk . ?mk rc:name "HYUNDAI" . FILTER(YEAR(?date) = 2024) } ORDER BY ?date ?campno

SELECT DISTINCT ?modelName ?makeName WHERE { ?c rc:affectsComponent ?comp . ?comp rc:name "SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE" . ?c rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:name ?modelName . ?m rc:ofMake ?mk . ?mk rc:name ?makeName } ORDER BY ?makeName ?modelName

sparql_tries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?campno WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber ?campno ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:modelYear ?y ; rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:name "SANTA FE" ; rc:ofMake ?mk . ?mk rc:name "HYUNDAI" . FILTER(STR(?y) = "2021") } ORDER BY ?campno

SELECT DISTINCT ?modelName WHERE {
  ?tm rc:name "TELLURIDE" .
  ?tv rc:ofModel ?tm .
  ?c1 rc:affects ?tv ; rc:affectsComponent ?comp .
  ?comp rc:name ?cn .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?cn, ":"))
  ?c2 rc:affectsComponent ?comp ; rc:affects ?gv .
  ?gv rc:ofModel ?gm .
  ?gm rc:ofMake ?mk ; rc:name ?modelName .
  ?mk rc:name "GENESIS" .
} ORDER BY ?modelName

SELECT ?modelName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?campaigns) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:name ?modelName . } GROUP BY ?m ?modelName ORDER BY DESC(?campaigns) LIMIT 10

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?count) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:reportReceivedDate ?d ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:ofMake ?mk . ?mk rc:name ?n . FILTER(?n IN ("HYUNDAI","KIA","GENESIS")) FILTER(YEAR(?d) = 2023) }

SELECT ?campaignNumber ?potentiallyAffected WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:parkOutside true ; rc:campaignNumber ?campaignNumber ; rc:potentiallyAffected ?potentiallyAffected . } ORDER BY DESC(?potentiallyAffected) LIMIT 1
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?count) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:initiatedBy ?i . FILTER(UCASE(STR(?i)) = "ODI" || CONTAINS(UCASE(STR(?i)), "ODI")) }
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?year) AS ?yearCount) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m ; rc:modelYear ?year . ?m rc:name "SONATA" ; rc:ofMake ?mk . ?mk rc:name "HYUNDAI" . }

SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:reportReceivedDate ?d ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:ofMake ?mk . ?mk rc:name ?mn . FILTER(?mn IN ('HYUNDAI','KIA','GENESIS')) BIND(YEAR(?d) AS ?year) } GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY DESC(?n)

SELECT DISTINCT ?campNo WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber ?campNo . { ?c rc:defectSummary ?t } UNION { ?c rc:consequenceSummary ?t } UNION { ?c rc:rootCause ?t } FILTER(REGEX(STR(?t), "hydrogen", "i") && REGEX(STR(?t), "leak|detect", "i")) } ORDER BY ?campNo

SELECT DISTINCT ?campNo ?compName WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber ?campNo ; rc:affectsComponent ?comp . ?comp rc:name ?compName . FILTER(CONTAINS(UCASE(?compName), "INTEGRATED CHARGING CONTROL") || CONTAINS(UCASE(?compName), "ICCU")) } ORDER BY ?campNo

SELECT DISTINCT ?campNo WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber ?campNo . OPTIONAL { ?c rc:affectsComponent ?comp . ?comp rc:name ?compName } OPTIONAL { ?c rc:defectSummary ?ds } FILTER( CONTAINS(UCASE(STR(?ds)), "ICCU") || CONTAINS(UCASE(STR(?ds)), "INTEGRATED CHARGING CONTROL") || (CONTAINS(UCASE(STR(?compName)), "12V") && CONTAINS(UCASE(STR(?compName)), "CHARG")) ) } ORDER BY ?campNo

SELECT DISTINCT ?campNo ?defect WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber ?campNo ; rc:defectSummary ?defect . FILTER(REGEX(?defect, "(water|moisture)", "i") && REGEX(?defect, "(tow|trailer|hitch)", "i") && REGEX(?defect, "(module|electronic)", "i")) } ORDER BY ?campNo
